## Load files

We import the design-files, count-tables and taxonomy files from *01_Import_Normalization.qmd*.

```{r}
#| label: import_4
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false

#Import RDS files
bDESIGN <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/bDESIGN.RDS")
bTAXA <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/bTAXA_norm.RDS")
bCOUNTm <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/bCOUNTm.RDS")
fDESIGN <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/fDESIGN.RDS")
fTAXA <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/fTAXA_norm.RDS")
fCOUNTm <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/fCOUNTm.RDS")
oDESIGN <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/oDESIGN.RDS")
oTAXA <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/oTAXA_norm.RDS")
oCOUNTm <- readRDS("interim/01_Import_Normalization/oCOUNTm.RDS")

```

## Remove host ASVs

Since we work with the raw read count table, "bCOUNTm" generated in the *01_Import_Normalization.qmd* file, we first need to remove the "Host" sequence

```{r}
#| label: remove Host ASVs
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
# Bacteria
host_asvs_b <- rownames(bTAXA)[bTAXA$labels == "Host"]
bCOUNTm <- bCOUNTm[!(rownames(bCOUNTm) %in% host_asvs_b), ]
bTAXA <- bTAXA[!(rownames(bTAXA) %in% host_asvs_b), ]

# Fungi
host_asvs_f <- rownames(fTAXA)[fTAXA$labels == "Host"]
fCOUNTm <- fCOUNTm[!(rownames(fCOUNTm) %in% host_asvs_f), ]
fTAXA <- fTAXA[!(rownames(fTAXA) %in% host_asvs_f), ]

# Oomycetes
host_asvs_o <- rownames(oTAXA)[oTAXA$labels == "Host"]
oCOUNTm <- oCOUNTm[!(rownames(oCOUNTm) %in% host_asvs_o), ]
oTAXA <- oTAXA[!(rownames(oTAXA) %in% host_asvs_o), ]

```

## Differential abundance analysis

### Differential abundances

We use the **Deseq** function from the **Deseq2** package to get differential abundant ASVs between plus and minus conditioned samples, between the lines and the interaction between coniditioning and line. This function performs an estimation of size factors and an estimation of dispersion, fits it to a negative biomial GLM model and peforms a Wald test an log2 fold changes.

```{r}
#| label: DESEq2 function
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
run_deseq_interaction_model <- function(counts, metadata, taxa_df,
                                        sample_col = "sample_name",
                                        condition_col = "condition",
                                        line_col = "line",
                                        ref_condition = "minus",
                                        ref_line = "WT",
                                        padj_cutoff = 0.05,
                                        lfc_cutoff = 1) {

  # --- Sanity checks ---
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(counts), is.data.frame(metadata), is.data.frame(taxa_df))
  stopifnot(sample_col %in% colnames(metadata))
  stopifnot(all(colnames(counts) %in% metadata[[sample_col]]))

  # --- Match metadata to counts ---
  metadata <- metadata[metadata[[sample_col]] %in% colnames(counts), ]
  metadata <- metadata[match(colnames(counts), metadata[[sample_col]]), ]
  rownames(metadata) <- metadata[[sample_col]]

  # --- Relevel factors for DESeq2 ---
  metadata[[condition_col]] <- relevel(factor(metadata[[condition_col]]), ref = ref_condition)
  metadata[[line_col]] <- relevel(factor(metadata[[line_col]]), ref = ref_line)

  # --- Create DESeq2 object ---
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts,
    colData = metadata,
    design = as.formula(paste("~", line_col, "*", condition_col))
  )
  dds <- DESeq2::DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)

  # --- Helper: extract and annotate results ---
  extract_annotated <- function(name, label) {
  res <- DESeq2::results(dds, name = name)
  
  # Remove pre-existing ASV column from taxa_df before joining
  taxa_clean <- taxa_df
  if ("ASV" %in% colnames(taxa_clean)) {
    taxa_clean <- taxa_clean %>% dplyr::select(-ASV)
  }

  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = label,
      signif = ifelse(!is.na(padj) & padj < padj_cutoff & abs(log2FoldChange) >= lfc_cutoff, TRUE, FALSE),
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        signif & log2FoldChange > 1  ~ "up",
        signif & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "down",
        TRUE                         ~ "ns"
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(taxa_clean %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("ASV"), by = "ASV") %>%
    dplyr::select(ASV, baseMean, log2FoldChange, padj, signif, direction, everything())

  return(res_df)
}

  # --- Extract results for each effect ---
  res_condition <- extract_annotated(paste0(condition_col, "_plus_vs_minus"), "condition")
  res_line <- extract_annotated(paste0(line_col, "_318_vs_WT"), "line")
  res_interaction <- extract_annotated(paste0(line_col, "318.", condition_col, "plus"), "interaction")

  return(list(
    condition      = res_condition,
    line           = res_line,
    interaction    = res_interaction,
    dds_object     = dds
  ))
}

```

```{r}
#| label: Run DESEq
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false

# Run model and extract results

results_full_model <- run_deseq_interaction_model(
  counts = bCOUNTm,
  metadata = bDESIGN,
  taxa_df = bTAXA,
  sample_col = "sample_name"
)

```

## Differential abundances heatmap

We perform a variance stabilization transformation and plot a heatmap with the differentially abundant ASVs.

```{r}
#| label: Heatmpa - vst
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false

# Prepare for Heatmap - variance stabalized counts

#1 Get all significant ASVs
sig_asvs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  results_full_model$condition %>% dplyr::filter(signif),
  results_full_model$line %>% dplyr::filter(signif),
  results_full_model$interaction %>% dplyr::filter(signif)
) %>% dplyr::distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

#2 Transform counts with VST and subset to significant ASVs
vsd <- DESeq2::varianceStabilizingTransformation(results_full_model$dds_object, blind = FALSE)
vsd_mat <- SummarizedExperiment::assay(vsd)
heatmap_data <- vsd_mat[rownames(vsd_mat) %in% sig_asvs$ASV, ]

#3 Prepare sample annotation
sample_annot <- bDESIGN %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_name %in% colnames(heatmap_data)) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_name, line, condition) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_name")

#4 Build binary ASV-level annotation
asv_ids <- rownames(heatmap_data)

asv_annotation <- data.frame(
  line = factor(asv_ids %in% results_full_model$line$ASV[results_full_model$line$signif], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
  condition = factor(asv_ids %in% results_full_model$condition$ASV[results_full_model$condition$signif], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE)),
  interaction = factor(asv_ids %in% results_full_model$interaction$ASV[results_full_model$interaction$signif], levels = c(FALSE, TRUE))
)
rownames(asv_annotation) <- asv_ids

#5 Convert logical to "yes"/"no" factors
asv_annotation <- asv_annotation %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ factor(ifelse(as.logical(.x), "yes", "no"))))

#6 Add genus names as row labels
asv_labels <- bTAXA[match(rownames(heatmap_data), rownames(bTAXA)), "genus"]
asv_labels[is.na(asv_labels)] <- "unassigned"
names(asv_labels) <- rownames(heatmap_data)

#7 Define annotation colors

annotation_colors <- list(
  line = c(yes = "#e3913e", no = "white"),
  condition = c(yes = "gold2", no = "white"),
  interaction = c(yes = "orchid", no = "white"),
  line_col = c(WT = "#01686c", `318` = "#e3913e"),
  condition_col = c(minus = "seagreen", plus = "gold2")
)

#8 Plot final heatmap

pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat = heatmap_data,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  annotation_col = sample_annot %>%
    dplyr::rename(line_col = line, condition_col = condition),
  annotation_row = asv_annotation,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  labels_row = asv_labels,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  fontsize = 7,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "firebrick3"))(50),
  main = "Differentially Abundant ASVs with DESeq2 Effects"
)

```

## Abundance of differentially abundant ASVs

We square-root-transform the abundance of all differential abundant ASVs and show their abundance.

```{r}
#| label: Import bCOUNTm_norm
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
#| paged-print: false
# Import the  normalised count table that was used during beta diversity analysis.
bCOUNTm_norm <- readRDS("interim/02_Taxa_Analysis/bCOUNTm_microbial_load.RDS")

```


```{r}
#| label: heatmap DF
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false
# --- 1. Sample metadata to group replicates
annot_df <- bDESIGN %>%
  dplyr::select(sample_name, line, condition) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_name %in% colnames(bCOUNTm_norm)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = paste(line, condition, sep = "_"))

annot_df <- annot_df[match(colnames(bCOUNTm_norm), annot_df$sample_name), ]
annot_df$group_readable <- gsub("318", "mmf1\\-2", annot_df$group)  # optional relabeling

# --- 2. Group mean abundance per ASV
group_means <- t(apply(bCOUNTm_norm, 1, function(x) {
  tapply(x, annot_df$group_readable, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
}))
heatmap_data <- as.data.frame(group_means)

# --- 3. Filter to significantly responsive ASVs
sig_asvs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  results_full_model$condition %>% dplyr::filter(signif),
  results_full_model$line %>% dplyr::filter(signif),
  results_full_model$interaction %>% dplyr::filter(signif)
) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(ASV, .keep_all = TRUE)

heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[rownames(heatmap_data) %in% sig_asvs$ASV, ]

# --- 4. Build annotation flags
asv_annotation <- data.frame(
  condition = rownames(heatmap_data) %in% results_full_model$condition$ASV[results_full_model$condition$signif],
  line = rownames(heatmap_data) %in% results_full_model$line$ASV[results_full_model$line$signif],
  interaction = rownames(heatmap_data) %in% results_full_model$interaction$ASV[results_full_model$interaction$signif]
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(everything(), ~ factor(ifelse(.x, "yes", "no"), levels = c("no", "yes"))))
rownames(asv_annotation) <- rownames(heatmap_data)

# --- 5. Genus labels for rows
asv_genus <- bTAXA[rownames(heatmap_data), "genus"]
asv_genus[is.na(asv_genus)] <- "unassigned"
asv_labels <- paste0(asv_genus, " (", rownames(heatmap_data), ")")
names(asv_labels) <- rownames(heatmap_data)

# --- 6. Define colors for row annotations
annotation_colors <- list(
  condition = c("yes" = "#D5A6BD", "no" = "white"),
  line = c("yes" = "#92C5DE", "no" = "white"),
  interaction = c("yes" = "#01686C", "no" = "white")
)
```


```{r}
#| label: Heatmap rel abundant
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| paged-print: false
# Load required libraries
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# 1. Compute mean abundance across the heatmap matrix
asv_mean_abund <- rowMeans(heatmap_data, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Assign significance classes and sort
asv_sorting_df <- asv_annotation %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ASV = rownames(.)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    significance_class = dplyr::case_when(
      condition == "yes" & line == "no" & interaction == "no" ~ "1_condition_only",
      line == "yes" & condition == "no" & interaction == "no" ~ "2_line_only",
      interaction == "yes" & condition == "no" & line == "no" ~ "3_interaction_only",
      (interaction == "yes" & (line == "yes" | condition == "yes")) |
        (line == "yes" & condition == "yes") ~ "4_multi_category",
      TRUE ~ "5_other"
    ),
    mean_abundance = asv_mean_abund[ASV]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(significance_class = factor(
    significance_class,
    levels = c("1_condition_only", "2_line_only", "3_interaction_only", "4_multi_category", "5_other")
  )) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(significance_class, desc(mean_abundance))

# 3. Reorder ASV rows
sorted_asvs <- asv_sorting_df$ASV
heatmap_data <- heatmap_data[sorted_asvs, ]
# Define the desired column order (sample groups)
desired_order <- c("WT_minus", "WT_plus", "mmf1-2_minus", "mmf1-2_plus")

# 4. Sqrt-transform and reorder columns
sqrt_heatmap_data <- sqrt(heatmap_data)
sqrt_heatmap_data <- sqrt_heatmap_data[, desired_order]

# 5. Plot heatmap without gaps
heatmap <- pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat = as.matrix(sqrt_heatmap_data),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_row = asv_annotation[rownames(sqrt_heatmap_data), , drop = FALSE],
  labels_row = asv_labels[rownames(sqrt_heatmap_data)],
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize = 6,
  border_color = "grey30",
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#FFF8DC", "firebrick3"))(1000),
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors,
  main = "Square-Root-Transf. Rel. Abundance of Differentially Abundant ASVs",
  angle_col = 90
)
heatmap

ggsave("Heatmap.pdf", plot = heatmap, width = 12, height = 12, units = "cm", path = "Output/Figures/")
```
